timeBase: utc_ms and rx_ms are Unix epoch milliseconds on the phone clock; rx_ms is when the packet arrived. Gait/hydration: utc_ms = device_ms (node millis) + a min-delay offset estimate (ClockSync); refit offline from rx_ms/device_ms if needed. Environment: utc_ms = arrival = end of the 10 s averaging window; device_utc_s is the node's GPS clock (whole seconds). Posture: utc_ms = when the pose was committed (held 10 s; onset is ~10 s earlier); live events use arrival time, replayed queue events the cushion clock (utc_source column).
